Fourteen teams participated with [[Al Ahli Club (Dubai)|Al Ahli]] as the defending champions after securing the championship last season for the first time since the [[2008–09 UAE Pro-League|2008–09 campaign]]. The league was started on 15 September 2014 and was concluded on 15 May 2015.{{cite web |url=http://web.agleague.ae/en/news/201415-season-schedule-confirmed.html|title=2014/15 Season Schedule confirmed |date=19 May 2014 |work=Pro League Committee |access-date=19 May 2014}} ==Teams== [[Al-Shaab CSC|Al Shaab]] and [[Dubai CSC|Dubai Club]] were relegated to the second tier being replaced by [[Ittihad Kalba FC|Ittihad Kalba]] and [[Fujairah FC|Fujairah]] who were both relegated in the [[2012–13 UAE Pro League|2012–13 campaign]].{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/united-arab-emirates/premier-league/20142015/regular-season/r26021/|title=Arabian Gulf League 2014/2015|work=Soccerway|publisher=Perform|access-date=13 August 2014}} ===Stadia and locations=== {{stack|{{Location map+ |United Arab Emirates |width=400 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2014–15 UAE Pro-League |places= {{Location map~ |United Arab Emirates |lat=25.25000 |long=55.30000 |label=
